Tidal]] }} '''Blastoise Transforms''' (Japanese: '''カメックス、化わる''' ''{{tt|Kamex|Blastoise}}, Change'') is the 607th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 12th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} With the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s in hand, [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] arrive in the [[Hoenn]] region. As the two conclude that the orbs are attempting to summon something catastrophic, voices call out to them from above. They look up to see {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Green}}, who have followed them from [[Kanto]]. They accuse Maxie and Archie of stealing the orbs, as well as injuring {{adv|Bill}} at the [[Sea Cottage]]. Vowing to stop them, Red and Green send out [[Saur]] and [[Blasty]], as Maxie and Archie send out {{p|Camerupt}} and {{p|Sharpedo}}. Red reveals that he had spent the last few weeks learning about the orbs from Bill. He recounts a phone call he had with him, where Bill explains that the Red and Blue Orbs are connected with {{p|Deoxys}}. Bill tells Red that in the Kanto region, [[Team Rocket]] had used the orbs to change Deoxys into its Defense Forme and Attack Forme. With [[Lanette]] and [[Brigette]]'s expertise, Bill comes to the conclusion that the orbs are solidified natural energy from Hoenn, and informs Red about it. He invites Red to come over to the Sea Cottage to have a look. When Red, Green, and [[Daisy Oak]] arrive the next day, they find Bill lying on the ground, injured. In the present, Green tells Archie and Maxie that their theft of the orbs was reported in the news, but the story had been overshadowed by the announcement of the oncoming [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]]. She and Red are surprised that the two already know of the meteor, and realize that the theft must be tied to it somehow. Archie and Maxie [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] both of their Pokémon, and Red and Green respond by doing the same. On the [[S.S. Tidal]], {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Emerald}} watch in shock as {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}} emerge from {{p|Hoopa}}'s rings. {{adv|Amber}} and [[Blaise]] are delighted that their plan to use Hoopa to lure in [[Legendary Pokémon]] worked. Reading the [[Scanner]], Blaise announces that the Red and Blue Orbs are in the Hoenn region, likely being brought by their former bosses. Emerald yells at Hoopa for summoning such dangerous Pokémon, and [[Ultima]], [[Mr. Briney]], and [[Drake]] run out to them. Ruby informs them that Hoopa must have been attacked by someone, then points out to where he had earlier seen a flash of light across the sea. {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}} tells Ruby that he has a plan to stop Groudon and Kyogre, and Ruby hops on his back and takes {{p|Diancie}} with him. When they reach the Legendary Pokémon, Ruby asks Diancie to use {{m|Moonblast}}. The attack stuns Groudon and Kyogre, pushing them backward, and allowing Ruby to locate Amber and Blaise. Emerald catches up to him with {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latias}}, and sends out his {{TP|Emerald|Dusclops}} while Ruby summons [[Feefee]]. The two Pokémon fight against Blaise's {{p|Slugma}} and Amber's {{p|Gorebyss}}, but are defeated. Suddenly, Groudon and Kyogre swim past Ruby and Emerald. To prevent the Pokédex holders from going after the Legendary Pokémon, Blaise has his Slugma create a powerful illusion around the two. Amber and Blaise escape, following Groudon and Kyogre, who are after the holders of the Red and Blue Orbs. Blaise smiles as he looks forward to utilizing the technique of [[Primal Reversion]]. When Blaise and Amber find the holders of the orbs, they are shocked to find that they look different from the Maxie and Archie they once served. At [[Meteor Falls]], a {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village|woman}} stares up at the sky as a {{p|Rayquaza|silhouetted Pokémon}} flies through, leaving a contrail in its wake. [[Renza]], [[Jinga]], and [[Tomatoma]] come running towards her, calling her "Elder" and warning her that two Legendary Pokémon have been spotted on {{rt|115|Hoenn}}. The Elder asks if the three have seen [[Zinnia]], then advises them not to judge her actions. As the three leave to find her, the Elder ponders the Dragon Lord's cloud trail in the sky. ==Major events== * {{adv|Green}} is revealed to own another {{p|Jigglypuff}}. * {{adv|Red}} and Green battle [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]]. * {{adv|Bill}} reveals that the {{i|Ruby}} and {{i|Sapphire}} have been regenerating back into the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s and believes them to be the embodiment of [[Hoenn]]'s natural energy. * Red, Green, Archie, and Maxie are revealed to be able to use [[Mega Evolution]]. * {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} fully emerge from {{p|Hoopa}}'s rings and begin heading towards the Red and Blue Orbs. * [[Blaise]] and {{adv|Amber}} are discovered by {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Emerald}}, but manage to escape. * Blaise and Amber meet with Archie and Maxie, but ask who they are. * [[Jinga]], [[Renza]], and [[Tomatoma]] head to [[Meteor Falls]], where they talk with the {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village}} about Groudon and Kyogre's awakening. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Mega Evolution|Mega Venusaur]]) * {{p|Blastoise}} ([[Mega Evolution|Mega Blastoise]]) * {{p|Camerupt}} ([[Mega Evolution|Mega Camerupt]]) * {{p|Sharpedo}} ([[Mega Evolution|Mega Sharpedo]]) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Emerald}} * {{adv|Bill}} (flashback) * [[Drake]] * [[Sird]] (flashback) * [[Archie]] * [[Maxie]] * {{adv|Amber}} * [[Blaise]]/{{tt|Mack|Chuang Yi}} * [[Daisy Oak]] (flashback) * [[Ultima]]/{{tt|Kimberly|Chuang Yi}} * [[Brigette]] (flashback) * [[Lanette]] (flashback) * [[Mr. Briney]] * [[Renza]] * [[Jinga]] * [[Tomatoma]] * {{OBP|Elder|Meteor Village}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Venusaur}} ([[Saur]];
